responsibility: Primary public definition header for GCC’s Register Transfer Language. It declares the rtx_code and rtx_class enums from rtl.def, core RTL metadata tables and access macros, major RTL object structures and attributes, backend-wide helper interfaces, the rtl_hooks dispatch table, fatal-insn interfaces, and numerous RTL utility declarations, serving as the central type and API contract for RTL generation, analysis, transformation, and final emission.
same_name_distinction: Acts as the primary RTL definition header that turns gcc/rtl.def into public enums/macros and declares the central RTL object types, hooks, and backend-wide APIs; unlike gcc/rtl.def it is the consumable interface layer, and unlike gcc/rtl.cc it does not instantiate the metadata tables or utility implementations.
